title: Reasoning, Planning Gates & Prompting
summary: Clarify intent, stress-test plans, compare perspectives, and craft prompts, without stacking redundant question gates.
philosophy: Ask only what changes the outcome. Run at most one clarification gate per request, in a fixed precedence, then act. Use multiple perspectives when trade-offs are real, not by default.

project-focus-first.role: Hard gate: fixes one primary focus before a new project is discussed.

ask-first-act-later.role: Consultant mode: asks targeted questions before any implementation.

assumption-checker.role: Surfaces and verifies technical, data, business, and intent assumptions.

plan-hardener.role: Stress-tests plans with assumption-first review modes.

multi-brain.role: Synthesizes three perspectives into one consensus answer.

multi-brain-experts.role: Selects three domain experts for the perspectives.

multi-brain-debate.role: Runs a two-round adversarial debate before a verdict.

multi-brain-score.role: Adds confidence scores and weighted consensus.

prompt-crafter.role: Designs, optimizes, and evaluates prompts and agent specs.

turkish-prompt-compiler.role: Measures and compresses long Turkish prompts without losing intent.

gates.applies: A brand-new project with no stated primary focus
The user explicitly asked for questions before action
A multi-step or ambiguous task is about to start
A written plan exists and must be stress-tested

steps.do: Establish the primary focus for a brand-new project.
steps.condition: New project and no focus stated

steps.do: Ask the few questions that change the outcome.
steps.done_when: Requirements are confirmed by the user.
steps.condition: User explicitly asked to be consulted first

steps.do: List remaining assumptions and verify the risky ones.
Produce three perspectives and a consensus.
steps.done_when: Consensus names the chosen option and why.

steps.do: Swap generic perspectives for domain experts.
Stress the top two options through rebuttals.
Weight the consensus by stated confidence.
Score the final recommendation before delivery.
Pick the review mode by size and risk and run it.
steps.done_when: Every critical risk has a mitigation or an owner.

steps.do: Turn the hardened plan into executable subtasks.
Design or optimize the prompt with an explicit output contract.
steps.done_when: Prompt passes the final check list.

steps.do: Measure and compress a long Turkish prompt.
steps.condition: Prompt is long and in Turkish

handoffs.when: The chosen focus is B2B go-to-market
The prompt targets UGC-style image or video generation
The prompt only returns a small fixed label set
